description: Current shared drill-library records seeded by the database. Supersedes the starter library migration.

value_notes.$database_time_at_migration_execution: timezone('utc', now()) at the time the migration runs

drills.name: 1. Ball Mastery in a Grid
drills.description: Players dribble freely while rehearsing core touches and turns. Use it to raise energy and ball contact volume quickly.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x20 yard grid. Each player has one ball. Coach calls surfaces, turns, and speed changes while players avoid contact.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Small touches in traffic

drills.name: 2. Dribbling Through Gates
drills.description: Players score by dribbling through cone gates under control. The drill warms up touch quality, scanning, and direction change.
drills.setup: - Set a 25x25 yard grid with 10-14 cone gates spread throughout. Each player has a ball and dribbles through as many different gates as possible.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Accelerate through gate

drills.name: 3. Passing Through Windows
drills.description: Pairs pass through a small cone window and follow their pass. It rehearses clean inside-foot passing before the main session.
drills.setup: - Set several 10-yard passing lanes with a 3-yard cone window in the middle. Put two or three players at each end with one ball per lane.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving

drills.name: 4. Three-Cone Passing Rotation
drills.description: Three players pass and rotate around a triangle. The pattern warms up passing rhythm, receiving angle, and movement after pass.
drills.setup: - Build 8-yard triangles. Place two players at one cone and one player at another, leaving one cone open. One ball starts with the first player.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving

drills.name: 5. Four-Cone Passing Rotation
drills.description: Players pass around a square and move to the next cone. It gives simple repetition for passing, receiving, and timing.
drills.setup: - Create 12x12 yard squares. Place players on three cones with one empty cone. One ball per square, with extra players waiting at the start cone.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving

drills.name: 6. Dynamic Partner Passing
drills.description: Pairs pass while moving through a lane. It prepares players for passing while their feet and body are active.
drills.setup: - Make 12x20 yard lanes. Partners start 8-10 yards apart with one ball and move up and back inside the lane while passing.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Keep spacing consistent

drills.name: 7. Handling Flighted Serves
drills.description: Players receive thrown or chipped balls in a circle. It warms up first touch with feet, thigh, and chest using age-appropriate service.
drills.setup: - Create a 20-yard circle. Half the players stand outside with balls. Receivers move inside the circle, check to a server, receive, and return the ball.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Cushion contact

drills.name: 8. Reaction Gate 1v1
drills.description: Attackers react to a coach signal and beat a defender through a gate. It warms up decision speed and competitive movement.
drills.setup: - Create 10x10 yard boxes with two cone gates on opposite sides. Pair players with one attacker and one defender. Coach calls the scoring gate.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Sell the first move

drills.name: 9. Rondo Activation 3v1
drills.description: Three attackers keep the ball from one defender. It activates scanning, support angles, and quick passing.
drills.setup: - Set 8x8 to 10x10 yard grids. Use groups of four with three outside attackers and one defender inside. Rotate defender after a win or timed round.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early

drills.name: 10. Possession Tag in a Grid
drills.description: Players dribble to protect their ball while taggers apply light pressure. It raises intensity and teaches shielding in traffic.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x25 yard grid. Most players have a ball. Two taggers without balls try to touch balls out of bounds; players re-enter after a ball mastery task.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Body between defender and ball

drills.name: 11. Dribbling With Turns
drills.description: Players repeat dribble-turn-accelerate actions in a grid. It builds control, balance, and direction change.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x20 yard grid. Each player has one ball. Coach demonstrates inside cut, outside cut, sole turn, and pullback.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Drop shoulder into turn

drills.name: 12. Ball Mastery Through Boxes
drills.description: Players work through small boxes using different touch patterns. It gives high-repetition footwork without long lines.
drills.setup: - Set 4x4 yard boxes across a 25x25 yard area. One player per box with one ball. Players perform coach-called touches for short intervals.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Stay light on toes

drills.name: 13. Dribbling in Traffic
drills.description: Players dribble in a crowded grid while avoiding pressure. It teaches close control and scanning under realistic congestion.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid for 10-14 players. Each player has one ball. Players dribble freely and respond to coach commands.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Protect ball with body

drills.name: 14. Shielding From Pressure
drills.description: Players protect the ball from a partner for short rounds. It teaches body position and patience when space is tight.
drills.setup: - Create several 8x8 yard boxes. Pair players with one ball. Attacker shields for 20-30 seconds while defender applies controlled pressure.
drills.coaching_points:
- Body between defender and ball
- Use arm for balance, not pushing
- Feel pressure before turning
- Keep ball on far foot

resources.label: Shielding From Pressure (Body Position + Ball Protection)

drills.name: 15. Turning Away From Pressure
drills.description: Players receive with pressure behind and turn or play back. It teaches when to spin, shield, or bounce pass.
drills.setup: - Use 12x15 yard channels with three players. Server passes to receiver in middle, defender starts behind, and target waits at far end.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Know defender before first touch

resources.label: Receiving Under Back Pressure (Turn or Set)

drills.name: 16. Moves Against Defender
drills.description: Players practice one attacking move then attack a live defender. It connects technique to a real 1v1 decision.
drills.setup: - Create 12x18 yard channels with a cone gate at the far end. Attackers start with balls, defenders begin 5 yards away.
drills.coaching_points:
- Attack defender at speed
- Change direction sharply
- Change speed after move
- Keep final touch forward

drills.name: 17. First Touch Through Gates
drills.description: Players receive and take first touch through a called gate. It links receiving shape with purposeful touch.
drills.setup: - Set 10x12 yard rectangles with a server on one side and receiver in middle. Place three colored gates around the receiver.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Touch with purpose

drills.name: 18. Juggling to Control
drills.description: Players juggle briefly then control and pass. It builds touch, balance, and confidence with bouncing or aerial balls.
drills.setup: - Use a 20x20 yard grid. Players work individually with one ball, then pair up for controlled service and return passes.
drills.coaching_points:
- Relax ankle on cushion
- Keep ball below waist
- Reset quickly after mistake
- Control before pass

drills.name: 19. Sole Control in Tight Space
drills.description: Players use sole rolls, pullbacks, and drag touches inside a small box. It improves escape touches and foot coordination.
drills.setup: - Set 5x5 yard boxes. One player and one ball per box. Work 30-45 second rounds with rest and coaching between rounds.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up between touches
- Use both feet
- Change speed after action
- Use sole to move ball across body

drills.name: 20. 1v1 Escape From Behind
drills.description: Receivers start with a defender tight behind them and must escape. It teaches shielding, turning, and protecting possession.
drills.setup: - Create 12x15 yard grids. Server plays into attacker with back to defender. Attacker scores by dribbling through either end gate.
drills.coaching_points:
- Feel pressure first
- Use far foot
- Spin when defender overcommits
- Play simple if trapped

drills.name: 21. Inside-Foot Passing Through Gates
drills.description: Players pass through a central gate and follow their pass. It builds clean technique and simple movement.
drills.setup: - Set 10-yard lanes with a 3-yard gate in the middle. Put two lines facing each other with one ball per lane.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving

drills.name: 22. Variable Distance Passing
drills.description: Pairs pass through a gate from increasing distances. It teaches weight of pass and accuracy over short to medium range.
drills.setup: - Create a 3-yard central gate. Mark passing lines at 5, 10, and 15 yards on both sides. Pairs complete passes before moving back.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Match weight to distance

drills.name: 23. Fixed Distance Passing
drills.description: Pairs pass and receive from a set distance with quality targets. It is a simple technical block for consistent repetition.
drills.setup: - Set paired cones 10-12 yards apart with one ball per pair. Keep pairs in lanes with enough room for first touch.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving

drills.name: 24. Triangle Combination Passing
drills.description: Players pass around a triangle with support movement. It teaches angles, timing, and playing around pressure.
drills.setup: - Create 10-yard triangles. Place one player at each cone with one extra at the start if needed. One ball moves around the triangle.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Check away then show

drills.name: 25. Wall Pass Combination
drills.description: Players execute a simple give-and-go around a cone defender. It teaches passing, movement, and receiving beyond pressure.
drills.setup: - Build 12x15 yard stations with a cone defender in the middle. Player A passes to Player B, runs around cone, and receives return pass.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Run immediately after pass

drills.name: 26. One-Touch Passing Pattern
drills.description: Players complete a short passing pattern with one-touch targets. It improves rhythm, timing, and body shape.
drills.setup: - Set a 15x20 yard pattern with four cones and 5-6 players. Start with one ball and rotate players after each pass.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Prepare body before ball arrives

drills.name: 27. Four-Corner Switching Passes
drills.description: Teams move the ball between corner boxes. It teaches changing the point of attack with support around the ball.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x40 yard grid with 5x5 yard boxes in each corner. Two teams play possession and score by passing into a corner box teammate.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Look long after short pass

drills.name: 28. Six-Cone Passing Movement
drills.description: Players pass and move through a six-cone layout. It reinforces accuracy, timing, and rotation after each pass.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x25 yard area with six cones in two staggered lines. Players pass through the pattern and follow to the next cone.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Arrive ready to receive

drills.name: 29. Long and Short Passing Sequence
drills.description: Players combine short support passes with a longer switch. It teaches pass selection and body preparation.
drills.setup: - Use a 20x35 yard rectangle with players at both ends and two support players central. Ball travels short-short-long, then repeats back.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set body for next pass
- Strike through middle of ball
- Support underneath long pass
- Receive side-on

resources.label: Long and Short Passing Sequence (Range + Support)

drills.name: 30. Passing With Moving Targets
drills.description: Players pass to teammates checking through gates. It teaches timing passes to a moving player rather than a standing cone.
drills.setup: - Set a 20x25 yard grid with four gates. Servers outside pass to runners who check through gates and return the ball.
drills.coaching_points:
- Lock ankle for clean contact
- Pass to the safe foot
- Move after the pass
- Scan before receiving
- Pass when runner is open

drills.name: 31. Receiving Across Body
drills.description: Players receive on the back foot and pass to the next side. It teaches open hips and playing forward quickly.
drills.setup: - Create 12x12 yard squares with players on three corners. Ball travels around the square with players receiving across body before passing.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available

drills.name: 32. Receiving With Back to Goal
drills.description: Players receive with pressure behind and decide to turn or set. It teaches realistic forward play for central players.
drills.setup: - Create 15x20 yard channels. Server plays into receiver with back to goal; defender starts behind; target waits opposite the server.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Protect ball first
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

resources.label: Receiving With Back to Goal (Turn or Set)

drills.name: 33. Receiving Facing Defender
drills.description: Players receive while a defender approaches from the front. It teaches first touch away from pressure and quick decisions.
drills.setup: - Create 20x30 yard grids with groups of three. One player serves across to a receiver while a defender closes from the opposite side.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Touch away from defender

drills.name: 34. First Touch Out of Pressure
drills.description: Players receive and exit through the least pressured gate. It trains scanning and purposeful first touch.
drills.setup: - Set 12x12 yard boxes with three colored gates. Server passes to receiver; coach or defender indicates pressure as ball travels.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available

resources.label: First Touch Out of Pressure (Scan + Exit)

drills.name: 35. Aerial Receiving and Return
drills.description: Players control tossed or chipped service and return cleanly. It builds confidence with bouncing and flighted balls.
drills.setup: - Create a 20-yard circle. Servers outside deliver age-appropriate tosses or chips to receivers inside, who control and pass back.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Cushion ball down

drills.name: 36. Checking Away to Receive
drills.description: Players check away from a cone defender before receiving. It teaches separation and timing before the first touch.
drills.setup: - Set 12x15 yard stations. Receiver starts near a cone defender, checks away, checks back, receives from server, and plays to target.
drills.coaching_points:
- Change speed to separate
- Show at an angle
- Receive on half-turn
- Call for ball late

drills.name: 37. Receiving Between Lines
drills.description: Players receive in a middle zone and play forward. It teaches body shape and awareness in central spaces.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x25 yard channel split into three zones. Server in one end zone, receiver in middle, target in far end zone.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Find window before pass

drills.name: 38. Directional First Touch
drills.description: Players take first touch toward a called target. It teaches control with intent rather than stopping the ball dead.
drills.setup: - Use a 15x15 yard grid with four colored gates. Server passes into receiver in center. Coach calls the exit gate as ball travels.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Touch into space

drills.name: 39. Receiving Under Contact
drills.description: Players receive while a defender applies shoulder-to-shoulder pressure. It teaches balance and secure possession.
drills.setup: - Create 10x12 yard grids. Server plays into attacker. Defender starts beside attacker and applies controlled body pressure.
drills.coaching_points:
- Wide base before contact
- Use far foot
- Do not lean back
- Secure ball before turn

drills.name: 40. Target Receiving and Layoff
drills.description: Target players receive, protect, and lay off to support. It teaches forward target play in a simple youth format.
drills.setup: - Create 15x20 yard channels with server, target, support runner, and defender. Server passes to target, target sets to support, then rotates.
drills.coaching_points:
- Check shoulder early
- Set pass softly
- Use body to protect
- Support runner talks early

drills.name: 41. 3v3 Plus 3 Possession
drills.description: Three teams keep possession with neutral support. It teaches angles, scanning, and quick transition after loss.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x20 yard grid. Use three teams of three. Two teams possess together against the third team, then switch on a turnover.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early

drills.name: 42. 4v4 Endzone Possession
drills.description: Teams keep the ball and score by finding a teammate in the endzone. It teaches possession with forward purpose.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x35 yard field with 5-yard endzones. Play 4v4 with one target or teammate entering the endzone to receive.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Penetrate when window opens

drills.name: 43. 4v4 Zone Possession
drills.description: Teams use zones to stretch the field and connect short and longer passes. It teaches support beyond the ball.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x24 yard field split into three horizontal zones. Play 4v4 with support players or targets in end zones if numbers allow.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Use the far option

drills.name: 44. 4v4 Corner Support Possession
drills.description: Teams use corner players as outlets to keep the ball. It teaches using support behind and around pressure.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid with one support player in each corner. Two teams play 4v4 inside and can pass to corner support players.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Use corners to escape pressure

drills.name: 45. 4v4 Plus Neutral Possession
drills.description: A neutral player creates overloads for the team in possession. It teaches finding the extra player and changing tempo.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x30 yard grid. Play 4v4 plus one neutral who always plays with the team in possession.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Find the free player

drills.name: 46. Triangle Goal Possession
drills.description: Teams keep possession and score through a central triangle goal. It teaches patience, angles, and timing final passes.
drills.setup: - Create a 35x35 yard grid with a 5-yard triangle goal in the center. Play 4v4 or 5v5 with a goalkeeper or neutral inside triangle if desired.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Change angle before scoring pass
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 47. Four-Corner Possession
drills.description: Teams score by receiving in corner boxes. It teaches spreading out, switching play, and recognizing open space.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x40 yard grid with 5x5 yard boxes in each corner. Play two teams; score by passing to a teammate checking into a corner box.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Switch before forcing pass

drills.name: 48. Keep-Away With Targets
drills.description: Teams keep the ball and connect to target players on the outside. It teaches playing out of pressure with support.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x30 yard grid. Play 4v4 inside with one target on each end line. Teams score by connecting target to target.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Support after target pass

drills.name: 49. Possession to Gates
drills.description: Teams keep the ball and score by passing through small gates. It rewards possession with purposeful penetration.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x30 yard grid with four 3-yard gates inside. Play 4v4 or 5v5. Teams score by completing a pass through any gate to a teammate.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Do not force closed gate

drills.name: 50. Transition Keep Ball
drills.description: Two teams react immediately when possession changes. It teaches quick counter-pressing and spreading out after winning the ball.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid. Play 5v5 keep-away. When a team wins it, they must complete the next pass to score a transition point.
drills.coaching_points:
- React on loss
- First pass after win is safe
- Spread quickly after regain
- Press together

drills.name: 51. 3v1 Rondo
drills.description: Three attackers keep the ball against one defender. It is the simplest rondo for support angles and first touch.
drills.setup: - Create 8x8 yard grids. Three attackers form a triangle around one defender. Rotate defender after a win or 60 seconds.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early

drills.name: 52. 4v1 Rondo
drills.description: Four attackers use the sides of a square against one defender. It teaches body shape, passing lanes, and patience.
drills.setup: - Create 10x10 yard grids. Four attackers stay around the outside with one defender inside. Rotate after defender wins ball or timed interval.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Stay on different sides

drills.name: 53. 4v2 Rondo
drills.description: Four attackers keep possession against two defenders. It increases pressure while keeping the organization simple.
drills.setup: - Create 12x12 yard grids. Four outside attackers play against two inside defenders. Rotate both defenders after winning possession.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Split defenders when available

drills.name: 54. 5v2 Rondo
drills.description: Five attackers keep the ball against two defenders. It teaches larger support shape and fast ball movement.
drills.setup: - Create a 14x14 yard grid. Five attackers position around the outside with two defenders inside. Use one ball and rotate defenders by time.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Keep ball moving

drills.name: 55. 4v4 Plus 1 Rondo
drills.description: Two teams play in a tight grid with a neutral player. It teaches finding the extra player under game-like pressure.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x15 yard grid. Play 4v4 plus one neutral who plays with the team in possession. Score by completing passes.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Use neutral to change angle

drills.name: 56. 4v4 Corner Rondo
drills.description: Teams use corner support players to keep possession. It teaches support angles outside the immediate pressure.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid with four corner players. Play 4v4 inside. Team in possession may use corner players as bounce options.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Use support before pressure traps you

drills.name: 57. Directional Rondo to Targets
drills.description: Teams keep possession and play into end targets. It connects rondo habits to forward play.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x25 yard grid with target players on both ends. Play 4v4 inside. Team scores by connecting from one target to the other.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Face forward when possible

resources.label: Directional Rondo to Targets (Keep + Play Forward)

drills.name: 58. Transition Rondo 4v4 Plus 3
drills.description: Players change roles quickly after a turnover. It teaches counter-pressing and immediate support.
drills.setup: - Create a 10x20 yard area. Use two teams of four plus three support players. Possession team uses supports; defenders transition when they win it.
drills.coaching_points:
- React first after turnover
- Secure first pass
- Support close and wide
- Press as a group

drills.name: 59. Rondo With Split Passes
drills.description: Attackers score bonus points by passing between defenders. It teaches patience and recognizing penetration lanes.
drills.setup: - Create a 12x12 yard grid. Play 4v2 or 5v2. Attackers keep possession and earn extra point for a clean split pass.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Split only when lane is open

drills.name: 60. Rondo to Mini Goals
drills.description: Possession team keeps ball then finishes into mini goals after a target number of passes. It adds purpose to the rondo.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x20 yard grid with two mini goals outside one end. Play 4v2 or 5v2. After five passes, attackers can score in either mini goal.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Speed up after pass count
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 61. Finishing From Layoffs
drills.description: Players receive a set pass and finish quickly. It teaches preparation touch, timing, and composed shooting.
drills.setup: - Use the top of the penalty area or a 20x25 yard shooting zone. One line serves to a set player, who lays off for a first-time or two-touch finish.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 62. 1v1 Finishing to Goal
drills.description: Attackers go at a defender and finish on goal. It teaches creating a shot under pressure.
drills.setup: - Use a 20x25 yard channel to goal. Attacker starts with ball, defender starts 5 yards away, goalkeeper optional.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Attack at speed
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 63. Diamond Shooting 1v1
drills.description: Players combine passes then play 1v1 to finish. It adds a competitive twist to shooting repetition.
drills.setup: - Set a diamond near the penalty area with 4 cones. Players pass through the diamond pattern, then attacker receives and plays 1v1 to goal.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- First touch creates shot
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 64. Crossing and Finishing
drills.description: Wide players serve balls for central runners. It teaches timing runs and finishing from wide service.
drills.setup: - Use half field or a 35x45 yard area. Place wide servers near channels and two finishing lines at the top of the box. Goalkeeper optional.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Time run, do not wait flat
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 65. Combination Finishing
drills.description: Players combine with a wall pass before shooting. It teaches quick passing around pressure and finishing in stride.
drills.setup: - Set a 25x30 yard area to goal. Attacker passes to support player, receives return pass around a cone defender, and finishes.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Shoot in stride
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 66. Small-Sided Shooting Game
drills.description: Teams play a small-sided game with frequent shooting chances. It teaches finishing decisions in realistic traffic.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x40 yard field with two goals. Play 5v5 or 6v6 with goalkeepers if available. Keep restarts quick.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Shoot when window opens
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 67. Four-Goal Finishing Game
drills.description: Teams attack multiple small goals to create shooting angles. It rewards quick decisions and changing point of attack.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x35 yard field with two small goals on each end line. Play 4v4 or 5v5. Teams can score in either goal they attack.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Change angle before shot
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 68. Turn and Finish
drills.description: Players receive with back to goal, turn, and shoot. It teaches first touch, shielding, and finishing quickly.
drills.setup: - Use a 15x20 yard channel facing goal. Server plays into attacker with back to goal near top of box. Defender optional behind attacker.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open body early
- First touch out of pressure
- Check shoulder before ball arrives
- Use back foot when available
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

resources.label: Turn and Finish (Receive Back to Goal)

drills.name: 69. Rebound Finishing
drills.description: Players shoot, then follow for rebounds. It builds the habit of staying active after the strike.
drills.setup: - Use one goal with a goalkeeper or rebound server. Shooters line up 15-20 yards out. After each shot, player follows to finish any rebound.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Keep running after shot
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 70. Endzone to Finish
drills.description: Teams must play into an endzone before shooting. It teaches final pass timing and finishing after penetration.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x40 yard field with a 5-yard endzone before goal. Teams play 4v4; a player must receive in endzone before finishing.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Arrive as ball arrives
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 71. First Defender Without Opposition
drills.description: Players rehearse approach, angle, and stance without live tackling. It teaches the first defender role clearly.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x30 yard area. Players work in pairs with one ball, moving through approach and jockey technique at coach pace.
drills.coaching_points:
- Close space under control
- Side-on body shape
- Force play one way
- Win it or delay

drills.name: 72. 1v1 Defending the Dribble
drills.description: Defenders stop an attacker from dribbling through a gate. It isolates pressure, patience, and body shape.
drills.setup: - Create 20x20 yard grids with two scoring gates. Attacker starts with ball; defender starts opposite and closes on first touch.
drills.coaching_points:
- Close space under control
- Side-on body shape
- Force play one way
- Win it or delay

drills.name: 73. Channel Defending 1v1
drills.description: Defenders protect a narrow channel and force the attacker wide. It teaches angle of pressure and patience.
drills.setup: - Create 10x18 yard channels with a gate at the end. Attacker tries to dribble through; defender starts 5 yards away.
drills.coaching_points:
- Close space under control
- Side-on body shape
- Force play one way
- Win it or delay
- Do not dive in

drills.name: 74. Recovery Defending 1v1
drills.description: Defender chases from behind to delay or win the ball. It teaches recovery runs and smart pressure.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x25 yard channel to a small goal. Attacker starts 3 yards ahead with ball; defender starts behind and recovers on coach signal.
drills.coaching_points:
- Sprint to recover line
- Slow down before tackle
- Force away from goal
- Stay in play after first block

drills.name: 75. Pressure Cover 2v2
drills.description: Pairs defend two attackers with pressure and cover. It teaches communication and second defender support.
drills.setup: - Create 18x22 yard grids with two small goals. Play 2v2 to goals. Rotate pairs every 60-90 seconds.
drills.coaching_points:
- First defender pressures ball
- Second defender covers space
- Talk early
- Step together when pass travels

drills.name: 76. Defending Through Gates
drills.description: Defenders score by forcing attackers away from target gates. It teaches steering and denying penetration.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x20 yard grid with three gates on one end. Attacker tries to dribble through any gate; defender protects and counters to opposite line.
drills.coaching_points:
- Close space under control
- Side-on body shape
- Force play one way
- Win it or delay
- Show attacker away from best gate

drills.name: 77. Compact Defending 3v3
drills.description: Defending team protects a central zone and shifts together. It teaches compactness without complex team tactics.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x30 yard field with two mini goals. Play 3v3. Mark a central lane defenders try to protect as ball moves.
drills.coaching_points:
- Stay connected
- Shift with the ball
- Protect middle first
- Press when touch is loose

drills.name: 78. Defensive Transition Game
drills.description: Teams react immediately after losing possession. It teaches counter-pressure and recovery shape.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid. Play 4v4 keep-away. On turnover, the team that lost it has five seconds to win it back.
drills.coaching_points:
- React on loss
- Nearest player pressures
- Others close passing lanes
- Recover goal side if press fails

drills.name: 79. Blocking Shots in Pairs
drills.description: Defenders close down and block without diving in. It teaches safe shot blocking and body control.
drills.setup: - Use a 15x20 yard channel facing a small goal. Attacker receives from server and prepares to shoot; defender closes from 5-7 yards away.
drills.coaching_points:
- Close fast, slow late
- Turn body slightly on block
- Hands tight to body
- Stay on feet

drills.name: 80. Defending Target Players
drills.description: Defenders deny passes into target players and recover when ball enters. It teaches marking, intercepting, and pressure after entry pass.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x30 yard grid with target players on end lines. Play 4v4 inside. Teams try to connect to targets while defenders deny lanes.
drills.coaching_points:
- See ball and target
- Step when pass travels
- Stay touch-tight near target
- Recover goal side

drills.name: 81. Width and Depth 4v4
drills.description: Players use field shape to create passing options. It teaches basic attacking spacing in a small-sided format.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x25 yard field with small goals. Play 4v4. Coach freezes briefly to show width, depth, and support angles.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Make field big in possession

drills.name: 82. Playing Wide From the Back
drills.description: Teams build out by finding wide outlets. It teaches using outside space instead of forcing central passes.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x30 yard field split into wide channels. Team starts from goalkeeper or end target and tries to play into wide channel before going forward.
drills.coaching_points:
- Open wide early
- Center backs support behind ball
- Do not force middle pass
- Play forward when wide player can turn

resources.label: Playing Wide From the Back (Build Out)

drills.name: 83. Switching Play Through Corners
drills.description: Teams move ball from one side to the other using support. It teaches recognizing pressure and changing the point of attack.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x40 yard grid with corner boxes. Play 5v5. Teams score by connecting passes into two different corner boxes.
drills.coaching_points:
- Look away from pressure
- Support behind the ball
- Receive facing the field
- Switch before space closes

drills.name: 84. Thirds Shape 4v4
drills.description: Players learn simple team shape across left, center, and right channels. It teaches spacing without overloading tactics.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x25 yard field divided into three vertical thirds. Play 4v4 with players encouraged to occupy different thirds.
drills.coaching_points:
- Keep one player wide
- Support central player
- Move as ball moves
- Do not crowd the ball

drills.name: 85. Target Player Build-Up
drills.description: Teams use a target player to connect forward. It teaches playing into feet, supporting underneath, and joining attack.
drills.setup: - Create a 35x25 yard field with target players on each end. Play 4v4 inside. Score by playing into target and receiving the return pass.
drills.coaching_points:
- Support target quickly
- Target sets ball safe
- Wide players stretch field
- Forward pass when target is open

drills.name: 86. Overload to Goal 3v2
drills.description: Attackers use a numbers-up moment to create a shot. It teaches pass or dribble decisions near goal.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x30 yard field to one goal or two mini goals. Three attackers start against two defenders and attack quickly.
drills.coaching_points:
- Commit defender before passing
- Support wide and central
- Finish before recovery arrives
- Defenders delay first
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 87. Counterattack From Regain
drills.description: Team wins the ball and attacks quickly into space. It teaches first pass after regain and forward runs.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x40 yard field with two small goals. Start with possession team in middle; defending team counters to goal immediately after winning ball.
drills.coaching_points:
- First pass forward if open
- Wide runners sprint early
- Keep attack simple
- Secure ball if counter is closed

drills.name: 88. Pressing Trigger 4v4
drills.description: Players learn simple cues to press together. It teaches when to step instead of chasing randomly.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x25 yard field. Play 4v4. Coach identifies triggers: bad touch, back pass, slow pass, player facing own goal.
drills.coaching_points:
- Press on bad touch
- Nearest player goes
- Teammates lock nearby options
- Stop if press is beaten

drills.name: 89. Building Through Zones
drills.description: Teams connect from defensive zone to attacking zone. It teaches patience, support, and playing forward at the right time.
drills.setup: - Create a 20x40 yard field split into three horizontal zones. Play 5v5. Teams score by moving the ball through each zone before finishing.
drills.coaching_points:
- Support behind and ahead
- Open body to play forward
- Use safe pass when blocked
- Move after pass to next zone

drills.name: 90. Rest Defense in Possession
drills.description: Players keep cover behind the attack during possession. It teaches simple balance and protection against counters.
drills.setup: - Create a 35x30 yard field. Play 5v5 to goals. Assign one player to stay connected behind the ball when team attacks.
drills.coaching_points:
- Keep cover behind ball
- Do not all run ahead
- Step up as team advances
- Stop counter early

resources.label: Rest Defense in Possession (Balance Behind Ball)

drills.name: 91. 4v4 to Small Gates
drills.description: Teams play 4v4 and score by passing or dribbling through small gates. It emphasizes forward passing and movement.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x25 yard field with an 8-foot gate on each end line. Play 4v4. Score by passing or dribbling through the opponent gate.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Play forward early when open

drills.name: 92. 4v4 With Target Players
drills.description: Teams use targets at each end to create realistic forward play. It teaches support around a forward pass.
drills.setup: - Create a 35x25 yard field. Play 4v4 inside with one target player behind each end line. Score by playing into target and receiving back.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Support after forward pass

drills.name: 93. 4v4 Zone Game
drills.description: Teams play through zones to create possession with purpose. It teaches short and longer passing choices.
drills.setup: - Create a 15x24 yard field split into three zones. Play 4v4 with quick restarts and coach spacing between rounds.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Use next zone when open

drills.name: 94. 4v4 Shape and Positioning
drills.description: Players play 4v4 with field thirds to guide spacing. It teaches simple roles and positional awareness.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x25 yard field divided into thirds. Play 4v4 to small goals with coaching on spacing and support.
drills.coaching_points:
- Stay connected
- Use width
- Support central option
- Recover shape on loss

drills.name: 95. 3v3 Plus 3 Game
drills.description: Three teams rotate between possession and defending. It creates many decisions with natural overloads.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x25 yard grid. Three teams of three. Two teams combine to keep ball from the third team; switch on turnover or time.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early

drills.name: 96. Endzone Small-Sided Game
drills.description: Teams score by receiving in an endzone. It encourages movement off the ball and passing into space.
drills.setup: - Create a 25x35 yard field with 5-yard endzones. Play 4v4 or 5v5. Score when a teammate receives a pass in the attacking endzone.
drills.coaching_points:
- Create passing angles
- Support near and far
- Play away from pressure
- Communicate early
- Run into space, not standing still

drills.name: 97. Four-Goal Small-Sided Game
drills.description: Teams attack two goals and defend two goals. It teaches scanning, switching, and choosing the best option.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x25 yard field with two mini goals on each end line. Play 4v4 with normal restarts.
drills.coaching_points:
- Head up before attacking
- Switch if one goal is blocked
- Defend as a group
- Use quick restarts
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

drills.name: 98. Wide Channel Small-Sided Game
drills.description: Teams get rewarded for using wide channels before scoring. It teaches width and service from wide areas.
drills.setup: - Create a 40x30 yard field with 5-yard wide channels. Play 5v5 to goals or mini goals. Award bonus for goal after wide-channel pass.
drills.coaching_points:
- Get wide early
- Support under wide player
- Cross or pass with purpose
- Recover centrally on loss

drills.name: 99. Transition Small-Sided Game
drills.description: Both teams attack immediately after winning the ball. It teaches quick reaction, counterattack, and recovery defending.
drills.setup: - Create a 30x35 yard field with two goals or four mini goals. Play 4v4 or 5v5. Coach keeps balls ready for fast restarts.
drills.coaching_points:
- React on turnover
- First look forward
- Recover goal side
- Keep tempo high

drills.name: 100. Finish Zone Small-Sided Game
drills.description: Teams must enter a finish zone before shooting. It teaches creating better chances instead of shooting too early.
drills.setup: - Create a 35x40 yard field with a 10-yard finish zone in front of each goal. Play 5v5. Shots only count from inside the finish zone.
drills.coaching_points:
- Set ball out of feet
- Pick corner before strike
- Follow rebounds
- Finish with composure
- Combine to enter zone
drills.equipment:
- Soccer balls
- Cones
- Training vests
- Goals or mini goals

resources.label: Finish Zone Small-Sided Game (Create Better Chances)
